0022600022.text: The Clippers (1-2, 1-0 at home, 0-2 on the road, currently on a two-game losing streak) visit the Timberwolves (3-2, 1-1 at home, 2-1 on the road, also on a two-game losing streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game, the Clippers' fifth game of the season. Los Angeles is missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps soreness) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 153-128 Clippers win in Los Angeles on March 11, 2026.
